ultimas_noticias.titulo: Dangote's Kenya Refinery Project Launches This Week at Up to $20B
ultimas_noticias.resumen_es: Kenya breaks ground September 30 on the Dangote-backed East Africa Oil Refinery in Lamu, a project priced at $17 billion by Kenyan officials and $20 billion by Aliko Dangote himself, and designed to process 700,000 barrels of crude oil a day at Lamu's deep-water port. It would serve Kenya, Uganda, South Sudan, Rwanda, Burundi and the Democratic Republic of Congo. ultimas_noticias.titulo: Glencore Joins Project Vault With $500 Million Cobalt Commitment
ultimas_noticias.resumen_es: Glencore committed $500 million to VaultCo, the Export-Import Bank public-private partnership sourcing critical minerals for a US government stockpile, Reuters reported Wednesday. The commitment makes Glencore the fourth supplier named to Project Vault, joining Hartree Partners, Mercuria Americas and Traxys seven months after EXIM's board approved the program's underlying loan. ultimas_noticias.titulo: Copper Erases Tariff Selloff as Shanghai Stockpiles Hit Three-Year Low
ultimas_noticias.resumen_es: Copper closed Tuesday a hair below its all-time high, extending its winning streak to six sessions as Chinese buyers restocked ahead of back-to-back holidays and warehouse inventories in Shanghai and London kept draining. Three-month copper on the London Metal Exchange settled at $14,783 a metric ton, up 0.8%, according to Shanghai Metals Market, leaving it $92 short of the $14,875 record set Sept. 10.
